content.text: Resolved T-2001. The report-renderer pods in `reports` show `OOMKilled` / exit 137 with a 512Mi memory limit, and logs show heap already at 431MiB mid-render on quarterly jobs — classic memory-limit OOM. I left a note on the ticket pointing the owner to raise the renderer's memory request/limit (e.g. 512Mi/1Gi) in its Deployment, with citations to the Kubernetes resource-management docs.
